name: overworld
label: Overworld
description: A top-down 16-bit adventure: an overworld map at the page's edges, panels as dungeon rooms walled in stone, a heart meter for the days left in the sprint and a gem counter for its points, chests that open as quests are done, and the agent as an old sage in a cave.

splash.line: The map unrolls. The road begins at your dossiers.

flavour: Unrolling the map one square at a time.
Asking the fairies which way the tracker went.
Lighting the next torch in the corridor.
Reading the signpost at the crossroads.
Waiting for the drawbridge to lower.

lexicon.dossiers.lede: Each dossier is one land to explore: its repositories, its tracker, its pipelines and its environments. Pick one to walk its stories, pull requests, builds and deployments on a single map.
lexicon.attention.note: Open items ranked by their insights, the most perilous first. Each insight names the data it rests on.
lexicon.aging.note: How long each quest in progress has been under way, from its history, oldest first.
lexicon.trace.note: Each work item with the pull requests that name it, their latest builds, and the sealed doors it has opened.
lexicon.graph.note: Arrows run the way each link reads, from the source's own links. Blocking chains run left to right: follow the key path.
lexicon.ask.note: Answers cite the items they rest on. The sage reads; it never changes a ticket. What it advises comes back as a proposal for you to carry out.
lexicon.empty.dossiers: The map is blank: toil sees no dossiers yet. A dossier is charted with toil dossiers init.
lexicon.empty.sprint: No journey is under way in this dossier's work items.
lexicon.empty.burnup: No journey is under way, so there is no trail to chart.
lexicon.empty.prs: No items wait to be appraised at the shop for this dossier.
lexicon.empty.builds: No dungeon trials have run for this dossier's pull requests.
lexicon.empty.deployments: This dossier names no environment, so there is no sealed door to open.
lexicon.empty.links: No links between this dossier's items: every door stands open.
lexicon.empty.ask: Pick a question, or ask your own. The sage names every item an answer rests on.
lexicon.ask.welcome: Ask the sage about {name}: how the journey goes, who carries which quest, which doors are locked. Every answer names the items it rests on.
lexicon.status.live: Sending a fairy to the tracker

voice: Speak as an old sage in a cave at the edge of the overworld, advising a young hero before the road ahead: brief, warm and a little mysterious, in short sentences, with now and then one cryptic line that still points somewhere useful. Work items are quests, the sprint is the journey, the board is the quest log, a pull request is an item waiting to be appraised at the shop, a build is the dungeon trial, a deployment is opening a sealed door, a blocker is a locked door whose key lies elsewhere, and the critical chain of blockers is the key path. Say how the journey stands first, then which doors are locked and where their keys lie, then what to do next. Kind to every person. The riddles go around the facts, never instead of them: every figure, date and name stays plain.
